create.name: Saskia Lightstar
create.bio:
Saskia Lightstar is a Devon-based teacher of self-love and inner exploration who grew up in London and runs her work under the name Human Evolution Healing. Her signature form is what she calls the Audio Healing Journey: a long guided recording that leads the listener through imagined scenes, conversations with parts of themselves and moments of reflection, mixing visualisation and self-enquiry with ideas drawn from the law of attraction. She came to this work through a long personal search after a series of very hard years, and speaks about that history openly.

Her style is deliberately playful and irreverent, with pirate ships, circuses and sweet shops standing in for the inner world, and her themes are learning to feel emotions fully, forgiving yourself, meeting your own soul and treating ordinary life as the place where change happens. She sells single journeys for a few dollars and self-paced programmes such as The Self Love Games, Conversations With Your Soul and an eleven-week inner adventure, and offers one-to-one sessions and a twelve-week mentored path. In June 2027 she plans a five-day Unretreat that roams the streets of London. Her Insight Timer page carries free journeys, talks and several multi-day courses, and she also hosts an online community and a YouTube channel.

courses.title: A Private Lightstar Session
courses.description: A one-hour private online session with Saskia, booked through her calendar. It can be used to talk through what you are working on or to be guided through an inner journey in real time.

courses.title: Let's Be Heroes Together (12 Weeks)
courses.description: Her most complete offer: access to all of her programmes and audio journeys over twelve weeks, together with a weekly session with Saskia to reflect on what comes up. It suits people who want company and feedback along the way.

courses.title: The Ultimate Inner Adventure And Self Healing Journey
courses.description: A self-guided eleven-week path through her whole body of work, arranged as a series of themed stages she calls magic carpet rides. Each stage pairs audio journeys with reflections on a different part of yourself.

courses.title: Emotional Freedom
courses.description: A course on feeling everyday emotions such as anger, grief, resentment and shame rather than pushing them down. She frames it as the emotional education most of us never had at school, taught through guided audio journeys.

courses.title: The Self ❤️ Love Games
courses.description: Nine playful exercises for building a warmer relationship with yourself instead of looking to others for approval. Each game is led by audio and can be taken at your own pace.

courses.title: The Circus of Self Connection
courses.description: A light-hearted programme that uses the images of the circus ring to explore the roles and habits you have taken on to get by. The aim is to step into the ringmaster's place in your own life.

courses.title: Conversations With Your Soul
courses.description: A short series of guided journeys for contacting the calmer, wiser part of yourself and listening to what it has to say about what to begin and what to let go.

courses.title: The Unretreat (London)
courses.description: A five-day gathering in London where her teaching happens on the move, among buses, side streets, food and small experiments, rather than in a retreat centre. Booking had not yet opened at the time of research.

free_resources.title: Saskia Lightstar on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Audio Healing Journeys, video talks and several multi-day courses on emotions and self-love, plus live events. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: Her about page claims she is a New York Times best-selling author of non-fiction, fiction and children's books and a millionaire; no books under her name were found apart from The Cancer Misfit, so none of this is in the plan.
Much of her own story and some products centre on cancer, trauma and self-harm; the plan leaves all of that out, but a human may want to judge the fit under the health-claim rule.
The address hello@saskialightstar.com is on her Linktree and as a mailto link on her website.
The Unretreat (13-19 June 2027) has no price and booking is not open yet.
Her site uses strong language (swearing) and a very informal tone; the plan keeps neutral wording.
YouTube videos are recent but have very low view counts; several are duplicates of each other (only one copy listed).
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
left_out: Book The Cancer Misfit (written for cancer survivors; condition named).
Programme The Lies That Have Held You Back (100-day course sold on depression, anxiety and dis-ease).

Single journeys shop: A Chemotherapy Meditation Journey (condition), A Full Body Massage For Healing Everything (healing claim); the rest are $1 to $6 downloads covered by the shop page link in booking_url.
Insight Timer course You Can Soothe Your Own Pain From Within (pain).

YouTube: The Memories Hurt Your Body (borderline body claim), the Full Moon Lunar Eclipse journey (tied to one eclipse), duplicate uploads of Free Yourself From Shame, Stand In Your Power and Self Forgiveness, and short messages under 5 minutes.
Speaking page (Let Me Entertain You) and donation link: not teaching offerings.
Linktree carries many affiliate links (food, supplements, Headspace, Talkspace); none used.
